claim: Block ownership and cached identity are distinct: free blocks may remain hash-indexed until reuse; writability requires sole ownership and absent cached hash.
KVCacheManager tracks grouped logical block allocations, prefix lookup and request release rather than directly allocating model tensor bytes.
Scheduling tracks computed versus required token progress; remote-KV completion and failed receive bookkeeping are separate, with recomputation/replay after retrieval.
Async scheduling reserves output placeholders, tracks pending structured output tokens, and uses worker-side draft IDs.
EngineCore constructs executor before KV planning and scheduler; ordinary step processes aborts before scheduler result updates and batch-queue execution may defer grammar-dependent sampling.
AsyncLLM registers requests and yields per-request output collectors; client cancellation and engine-dead failures follow different exception paths.
Output processing owns request output assembly and incremental detokenization rather than HTTP framing.
Grammar futures can become completed grammar or stored exception; grammar readiness is not itself evidence of successful compilation.
StructuredOutputManager fixes one backend per engine, compiles per-request grammars, and lazily creates request-local reasoning parsers.
Executor selection is based on normalized distributed_executor_backend including uni, mp, ray and external launcher choices.
The uniprocess executor creates and initializes its driver worker before loading the model and can return executor futures without promising separate-process execution.
GPU worker lifecycle separates device initialization, model loading, memory profiling, and KV-cache initialization.
GPUModelRunner updates persistent state and prepares inputs from SchedulerOutput; execute_model returning None requires a following sample_tokens operation.
Attention selection uses model/platform/configuration properties and supports per-kind overrides; KV-layout resolution covers the model backends together.
Loader selection uses load format, and get_model delegates model construction/loading to the selected loader.
Sampler applies logit processors, samples tokens, and returns GPU tensor output; raw and processed logprob modes have different semantics.
Scheduler tests cover active-sequence caps, finished speculative request caching, and avoiding cache publication of in-flight async tokens.
VllmConfig aggregates subsystem configuration and its constructor resolves cross-subsystem constraints.
Base loader creates modules under dtype/device contexts, loads named weights, clears transient allocator state, and post-processes weights before model.eval.
Qwen3Model inherits Qwen2Model loading; Qwen3ForCausalLM delegates loading to AutoWeightsLoader.
Qwen2Model maps separate Q/K/V checkpoint names to qkv_proj with q/k/v shard identities.
AutoWeightsLoader traverses child modules and delegates to model-specific loaders where available.
QKVParallelLinear uses output-dimension packing and head partitioning; grouped-query KV heads may be replicated rather than split into equal thirds.
Under async scheduling and pipeline parallelism num_computed_tokens can optimistically include in-flight steps, so the counter alone does not certify materialized KV.
SchedulerOutput describes iteration work while NewRequestData and CachedRequestData carry different request-state update forms.
Runtime CUDA-graph dispatch chooses only initialized valid batch keys and can return FULL, PIECEWISE, or NONE according to supported execution modes.
Tests distinguish a pending grammar Future from a completed Future whose result is a stored compilation exception.
Partial-hit copy-on-write retains copy endpoints until execution; model-specific running-tail handling can move cached hash identity before overwriting the former source.
Output-processor tests cover request output assembly; collector merges delta outputs when producer outpaces consumer.
Preprocessing-error test distinguishes rejected input from a permanently dead engine.
CommonAttentionMetadata explicitly distinguishes exact GPU lengths from CPU upper bounds under async speculative decoding.
FlashAttention cache update forms separate key/value views and uses unpadded slot-mapping length to bound writes from padded tensors.
Classic runner tests validate preservation of allowed-token masks during swaps and clearing stale masks on condensation.
Classic block-table move test asserts clearing the vacated row.
Sampler tests exercise allowed-token, presence/frequency/repetition penalty behavior.
Penalty helper derives prompt/output repetition masks and output-only frequency/presence penalties.
Repetition penalty kernel divides positive repeated-token logits and multiplies negative logits.
Model-parallel initialization creates distinct tensor/pipeline groups; world-size-one all-reduce bypasses communication and retained async handles preserve source tensor lifetime.
PyNccl all-reduce enqueues ncclAllReduce on a selected CUDA stream and checks input-device ownership.
NIXL worker polling tracks failed receives independently and may include ended failed requests in completion bookkeeping.
NixlConnector is the backward-compatible pull/READ alias, separate from push/WRITE behavior.
Async scheduler tests exercise placeholder progress and iteration bookkeeping.
Rejection sampler tests establish proposal acceptance/sampling semantics rather than end-to-end throughput.
Grammar validate_tokens returns an accepted prefix without FSM mutation; a false accept_tokens result must preserve prior grammar state.
Prefill statistics split total prompt work into local compute, local prefix hits, external cached tokens, and cache creation.
Multiprocess metrics directory lifecycle can cause inaccurate exports when user-managed stale state persists across runs.
EngineGenerateError is documented recoverable while EngineDeadError represents unrecoverable core death and separates log/client messages.
